method.statement: Each artefact named below was opened at the candidate commit and its declared schema, producer, consumer and identity fields were read from the artefact itself or from the tool that reads it. Population counts were recomputed from the tracked files at the candidate, not copied from a receipt. Where a receipt and the artefact disagree, the recomputed value is recorded here and the disagreement is a finding in FINDINGS.json.
not_done: No artefact was regenerated: A0 inventories identity and reconstructability, it does not rebuild a record.
No consumer in another repository was inspected: only tools in this tree that read the artefact are named.
The 228 artefacts excluded from freshness tracking by the 512 KiB bound were not opened; they are listed by the exclusion record, not by this inventory.

JSON Lines (forensics/downstream/authority-baselines.jsonl and sibling corpus files)
SHA-256 digest lists (MANIFEST.json inputs and .sha256 style records)

No statement payload or predicate type is defined; references occur only in queue and research documents.
